faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about compatibility, shipping, and profile management.
faq_q1: Do recipients need an app to view my profile?
faq_a1: No. AURA CARD works natively with modern iPhone and Android devices. A simple NFC tap or QR scan automatically opens your profile in their standard browser.
faq_q2: How long does shipping take in Morocco?
faq_a2: Standard delivery takes 24 to 48 hours to Casablanca, Rabat, Marrakech, Tangier, and major Moroccan cities.
faq_q3: Can I update my profile after ordering?
faq_a3: Yes. Your digital profile can be updated at any time from your customer dashboard. First publication is 100% free.
faq_q4: What happens if I lose my physical card?
faq_a4: You can immediately suspend the lost card from your dashboard to prevent unauthorized taps. Ordering a replacement card automatically restores your existing profile.
faq_a5: We accept bank wire transfer (Virement bancaire) and direct agency cash deposit across all Moroccan banking branches (Attijariwafa Bank, Bank of Africa, Cash Plus, Wafacash).
